high_value_findings.finding: The same historical neighborhood that later documents an intention-to-action observation also contains explicit prompt grounding, agency/consequence rewards, passive-description penalties, anti-enumeration/cliche filters and routing changes that shape reflection outputs.
high_value_findings.transfer: Any emergence/agency attribution from this lineage requires scaffold ablations and truthful-vs-shuffled shared-state controls before causal promotion.

high_value_findings.finding: Fresh-host and runtime failures repeatedly drove specific guards: installed-service filtering, memory corrections, venv validation, dependency/path corrections, seeded deployment state and explicit schema migration.
high_value_findings.transfer: Treat negative deployment/runtime evidence as architecture memory; preserve exact failure oracle and regression test rather than only the final fix.

high_value_findings.finding: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS did not migrate an existing schema; the missing column made transition recording fail silently because errors were debug-caught. Explicit schema introspection plus ALTER restored writes and live observations verified recovery.
high_value_findings.transfer: UnifiedDB/ClayGraph migrations need versioned schema checks, loud write-failure telemetry, migration receipts and post-migration write/read validation.

high_value_findings.finding: A centralized stabilizer introduced clipping, decay, weight anchoring and drift monitoring but integrations deliberately fail open to legacy behavior on stabilizer errors.
high_value_findings.transfer: Fail-open learning stabilizers require explicit availability/activation telemetry; otherwise a safety mechanism can silently disappear while training continues.

high_value_findings.finding: Thalamus/NAc/ACC/Amygdala/immune/intent/cortex coupling was materially implemented through explicit event weights, cached-state gathers, gating and context injection.
high_value_findings.transfer: Later causal-emergence tests must separate emergent cross-module effects from deterministic coupling rules and hand-set gains.

negative_results_preserved: Uninstalled services caused watchdog/immune restart cascades before installation-state gating.
Invariants daemon memory limits were below observed build demand and triggered systemd termination.
Fresh Ubuntu deployment exposed stale venv reuse, wrong write paths, missing ML dependencies and brittle network install behavior.
Subconscious transition writes silently failed because schema creation did not migrate an existing table and exceptions were debug-only.
Agency-like/reflection-quality outputs in this lineage were explicitly shaped by prompts, regex filters and score bonuses/penalties; they are not clean unscaffolded emergence evidence.
epistemic_boundary: The March 4 intention-to-action narrative is preserved as a historical observational claim with described log evidence and a plausible shared-state path, not promoted here to proof of phenomenal consciousness or unscaffolded causal emergence. Historical persona claims and output-policy language are design/runtime context, not scientific evidence by themselves.
